title: CoinbaseCartel Ransomware Attack Targets RXPE Group
content_md: Summary On August 22, 2026 , the ransomware group CoinbaseCartel claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against RXPE Group ( rxpe.com ), a leading energy company based in China. The group threatens to release sensitive information unless their demands are met. Incident Report Field Details Target RXPE Group Domain rxpe.com Country China Attacking Group CoinbaseCartel Date Reported August 22, 2026 Threat Actor Statement N/A The RXPE Group is currently assessing the full impact of the attack and working with cybersecurity experts to mitigate potential damages. Further updates will be provided as more information becomes available. Recommended Security Actions Ransomware attacks are increasingly targeting both enterprise and mid-sized organizations across all sectors. The following steps are critical to reduce impact and prevent future incidents: Monitor continuously: Use DeXpose’s dark web and infostealer monitoring platform to detect breached credentials, leaked databases, and threat actor chatter in near real-time—before damage spreads internally.
